### New Integrations


- [Dashboard ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/dashboard-eld)
- [Omnitracs OT1](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/omnitracs-ot1)


### Integration Updates


- [Raven Connected](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/raven-connected) now supports[Historical Vehicle Locations](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-location) and expanded[Vehicle Stat Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-stat-log) telemetry coverage
- [Verizon Reveal](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/verizon-reveal) now improves vehicle ID normalization so vehicles and related records join more reliably


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now includes driver and trailer detail pages with richer fleet entity context and trailer live-location visibility


### Documentation Updates


- Updated[S3 destination configuration documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/aws-s3-destination) with a copy/paste setup template and clearer defaults
- Updated[Spireon FleetLocate documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/spireon-fleet-locate) with published sample-rate and available-history data characteristics
